detail.longDescription: 🎉 Part-DB 2.19 has been released - You can now view 3D models directly inside Part-DB:. all common file types are supported: stl, 3mf, obj, step, iges, etc. Other new features include an improved footprint gallery and optional new footprint images generated from # KiCad 3D models. See full release notes: https:// github.com/Part-DB/Part-DB-ser ver/releases/tag/v2.19.0 # kicad # electronics # opensource # selfhosted # makerspace # hackerspace # maker
